codes.means: steps wait on each other in a circle
codes.fix: break the cycle in the after lists

codes.means: a step waits on an id that is not a step
codes.fix: fix the after list

codes.means: an effort or lead says neither estimate nor measured
codes.fix: write (estimate, <who>, <YYYY-MM-DD>) or (measured, <run>) after it

codes.means: an estimate does not say whose and when, or a measurement does not name its run
codes.fix: complete the source: (estimate, <who>, <YYYY-MM-DD>) or (measured, <run>)

codes.means: a gate names an agent; an agent can never pass a gate
codes.fix: make a person the gate's actor

codes.means: a step asks a person for more than four hours of effort
codes.fix: split it into atomic actions of at most four hours

codes.means: a finite superproject's map does not end in a milestone
codes.fix: add the deliverable as a milestone

codes.means: an open step asked of someone outside the team has no fallback
codes.fix: add fallback: what happens if they do not answer

codes.means: an open step asked of someone outside the team has no window
codes.fix: add window: <YYYY-MM-DD>..<YYYY-MM-DD>

codes.means: the map does not parse: an unclosed header, unreadable YAML or a malformed step
codes.fix: fix the line the finding names

codes.means: a scenario moves an id that is not a step
codes.fix: fix the scenario, or add the step

codes.means: scenarios exist and not exactly one is marked working
codes.fix: mark exactly one scenario working

codes.means: an actor is not agent, a person slug or outside: <name>
codes.fix: rewrite the actor in one of those forms

codes.means: two steps share an id
codes.fix: give each step its own id

codes.means: a step's kind is not work, wait, gate or milestone
codes.fix: set kind to one of those

codes.means: a step other than a milestone names no actor
codes.fix: set actor to agent, a person slug or outside: <name>

codes.means: an open gate or milestone has no provisional date
codes.fix: add target: <YYYY-MM-DD> (provisional)

codes.means: the folder holds both ATOMIC-ACTION-MAP.md and the legacy PLAN.md; only ATOMIC-ACTION-MAP.md is read
codes.fix: merge anything PLAN.md still says into ATOMIC-ACTION-MAP.md, then delete PLAN.md

codes.means: the file names no standard, the unversioned URL of its kind (written before standards had versions), or another kind's standard
codes.fix: superprojects migrate --root superprojects --stamp-standard --apply

codes.means: the file names a version of its standard that this version of @supersuit/superprojects does not implement
codes.fix: upgrade @supersuit/superprojects to a version that implements it; never stamp a newer record back
